$comment: AUTHORITATIVE. The migrated Item Details route's complete request and action ledger, frozen for tesserafin-web#129 Step 1c. Derived from the slice source (adapters/itemDetailsApi.ts, api/useItemDetails.ts, hooks/useItemActions.ts, components/*) and verified against observed execution by tests/itemDetails/itemDetails.ledger.test.tsx. docs/tesserafin/item-details-request-action-ledger.md is derived from this file and held to it by tests/itemDetails/ledger.consistency.test.ts. tests/fixtures/item-details/legacy-contract.json is the HISTORICAL P5 record of the retired route and is not superseded by this file — the two answer different questions.

historicalContract.subject: the retired legacy view-manager route, re-pointed at the migrated route in #134
historicalContract.frozenBy: PR #133 (61ee617b), re-pointed at the migrated route by PR #134 without editing the fixture

route.registration: ASYNC_USER_ROUTES -> toAsyncPageRoute, in BOTH route families
route.serverSelection: params.serverId ? ServerConnections.getApiClient(serverId) : ServerConnections.currentApiClient() — selects the SERVER, never the item
route.contextParameter: params.context is forwarded to link building only; it changes no request

presentationBinding.note: Step 1c freezes behaviour. Step 2 binds the recipe, and must preserve every row below.

phases.description: the item and the acting user, in ONE Promise.all. Either rejection is one failure.
the UserDataChanged subscription, bound in a mount effect once the item is known.
the section fan-out. Unordered with respect to each other; every member depends on `primary`.
reads issued by the one imperative adapter, components/recordingcreator/recordingfields.
URL builders invoked while drawing. Their distinct argument sets are frozen; their call counts are not.
requests issued only when a control is activated.

causality.note: No total order is imposed. Rows in the same `group` are intentionally concurrent; `dependsOn` records the only ordering the route guarantees.

surfaces.description: the jellyfin-apiclient instance returned by ServerConnections, reached only through adapters/itemDetailsApi.ts

effectFrontier.note: ServerConnections — the legacy apiClient and the SDK Api for this route
play, replay, instantMix, shuffle, playTrailers; also the canPlay/getSupportedCommands capability gates
dynamically imported at click time by cancelTimer and cancelSeriesTimer
the one imperative adapter; owns its own reads and controls

navigate("livetv") after a series timer is cancelled
dynamically imported by the route module to clear the chrome title
renders the six metadata link lists
query keys and invalidation; issues nothing itself
AppFeature gates for downloads and external links
the TV-layout gate on external links
derives display strings from the item
derives display strings from the item
the published design system: MediaCard, MediaGrid, EmptyState, ErrorState, LoadingState
